verdict: Maybe. Mudgar Club pitched traditional Indian fitness tools on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal. Mudgars, gadas and clubs are trending with functional-fitness fans, and there are few branded options, but the market is still niche.
angle: Traditional Indian training tools such as the mudgar and gada are getting new attention from fitness creators and functional-training gyms. They are simple to make but heavy to ship. Content that teaches how to use them safely is what turns interest into sales.
